text:
Alex Kim: Hey team — first week and I'm stuck on cloud access. I can log into SSO but don't have access to our GCP project or the AWS billing console. I need to run some infra tests in eu-west1 and link my account to the billing account. Any pointers on who to add me to which roles?
Jamie Liao: welcome Alex! :tada: quick q — do you need editor-level or just viewer+deploy rights?
Alex Kim: thanks! I just need to run infra smoke tests and deploy a tiny test service, so probably deploy-level for the dev projects and read access to billing. Not prod.
Jamie Liao: OK. Tagging cloud-ops: @Sam O'Neill — can you help with GCP project + AWS billing?
Sam O'Neill: @Alex Kim welcome. For GCP we usually grant two things: 1) project-level roles like `roles/viewer` + `roles/owner` only if needed, but for deploys we give `roles/editor` on the dev project or `roles/cloudrun.admin`/`roles/compute.instanceAdmin` depending on infra. 2) Billing needs `roles/billing.user` on the billing account. For AWS, we add you to the `Redwood-Engineers` IAM group which has console access to billing (read) and deploy permissions in non-prod accounts.
Alex Kim: perfect — what info do you need from me to create the requests?
Sam O'Neill: Send me: your full name, email (`alex.kim@redwood.com`), the GCP project IDs (if you know them) or say "all dev projects", and the AWS account aliases (e.g., `redwood-dev-12345`) or just say `dev accounts`. Also tell us which regions: you said `eu-west1` only?
Alex Kim: yes eu-west1 only. Projects: I think `redwood-dev-eu` and `redwood-eval`. AWS: dev account alias `redwood-dev`.
Priya Kapoor: tagging from finance — for billing access we'll need the billing account ID (PMs usually paste it in onboarding ticket) and a short justification. If you need charge-viewing only, mention "cost visibility for development tasks".
Alex Kim: thanks @Priya — billing account id is `BILL-0a1b2c3d4e`. Justification: "needs cost visibility for infra smoke tests and to set up budget alerts for dev workloads."
Miguel Torres: Also FYI — org policy currently restricts new service account creation in eu regions unless approved. If you need SA creation, mention that in the request and we'll fast-track it. For quick deploys you can use the team service account after I add you as a allowed member.
Alex Kim: good to know — I'll include SA creation in the request in case we hit that.
onboarding-bot: Ticket #INC-4821 created and assigned to `cloud-ops` (Sam O'Neill). ETA 2 business days. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821
Sam O'Neill: Thanks — I've started the GCP billing grant and added a temporary dev-editor role to `alex.kim@redwood.com`. Give it ~15 min then try `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-dev-eu` or attempt a small deploy. If anything 403s ping me here.
Alex Kim: confirmed I can access `redwood-dev-eu` now, can see billing. Trying a Cloud Run deploy now.
Sam O'Neill: Nice — if deploy succeeds I'll convert the temp role to the standard group membership and close the ticket.
Alex Kim: deploy succeeded. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
Jamie Liao: awesome — ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of our dev deploys later today.
Priya Kapoor: also added Alex to the cost dashboard with read access.
Sam O'Neill: Closing loop: ticket INC-4821 will be annotated and closed after group membership is finalized. Welcome aboard again, Alex.
Alex Kim: appreciate the help — excited to be here!
